metadata.source: Derived from ga-member-votes.json (legis.ga.gov SOAP roll calls)

methodology.partyUnity: Share of party-line roll calls (own-party majority opposite the other party's majority) on which the member voted with their own caucus. Excludes lopsided and bipartisan votes.
methodology.participation: Share of the member's own-chamber passage roll calls on which they cast a Yea or Nay; Other (absent/excused/not voting/present) counts against it.
